findings.text: the superseded arm cannot fire for a run resumed after its previous attempt wrote a manifest, because resumption.py:778 records that manifest's own mtime as the new attempt's baseline and _fresh_manifest (strict runs._manifest_freshness, promotion.py:3313) then returns None, so the guard is silent exactly where the goal wants a refusal; probe-guard.log case A returns ADMITTED with recovery._worker_launched_after_manifest True.

the new file ends without a trailing newline, adding a W292 finding to a repository whose rule is that a commit adds none; ruff check --no-cache over the two changed paths reports it and ruff format --check would rewrite the file.

the wording the done-when names is pinned by nothing: tests/test_a_live_worker_still_owes_its_review.py:149-151 assert "no complete independent review is stored" and "is classified running", both of which the replaced "because" sentence also contains, so a revert stays green.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against cf729cc7d; 94ed8d38d changes reckon/crew/promotion.py (+42/-7) and adds the 203-line test, 4d6dd38f2 adds the 45-line evidence fragment, and nothing outside the declared scope changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names a resumed run with a live worker pid and a complete manifest written before that attempt's launch, refused by crew complete; tests/test_a_stale_manifest_does_not_license_promotion.py:163 builds a first-dispatch pointer whose baseline is 0 (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4793) with the manifest dated 120s before the launch, so the named record shape is measured nowhere, and the head gate arm (logs/head-suite.log) runs the same 38 pre-existing files.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that _require_worker_stopped_before_promotion refuses a run whose terminal manifest predates the live attempt's launch; the landed arm at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3419 also requires strict freshness, and a resume records the inherited manifest's own mtime as its baseline (reckon/crew/resumption.py:778), so the case the goal names is not refused.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete with every key filled, the five cited logs exist, negative_control_log is a bare path whose first line repeats the declared mutation and whose last line is EXIT=1, and both suite arms carry completed true with no added failure id.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_stale_manifest_does_not_license_promotion.py, one evidence fragment and a figures directory; git show --stat of 94ed8d38d and 4d6dd38f2 lists exactly the first three, so the figure is correctly unwritten.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control.log shows the stale-manifest case reddening when the terminal-manifest-only admission is restored, but no case covers a resumed pointer, and the wording change at reckon/crew/promotion.py:3764 is unpinned because tests/test_a_live_worker_still_owes_its_review.py:149-151 asserts substrings the replaced sentence also carries.
justifications.evidence: the arms in logs/base-suite.log and logs/head-suite.log are literal, EXIT-terminated and add no failure id, but they measure the same 38 pre-existing files and the new cases at tests/test_a_stale_manifest_does_not_license_promotion.py:163 build a fixture whose baseline is 0 rather than a resumed pointer.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion.py:3412 imports the recovery helper inside the function as the file does at :3808, and the guard reuses _worker_launched_after_manifest rather than composing a second reading as the done-when asks.
justifications.goal_fidelity: probe-guard.log case A feeds the resume shape (baseline equal to the inherited manifest's mtime, worker launched 60s later) into reckon/crew/promotion.py:3419 and gets ADMITTED while recovery._worker_launched_after_manifest is True.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat for 94ed8d38d and 4d6dd38f2 lists only reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_stale_manifest_does_not_license_promotion.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/a-stale-manifest-does-not-license-promotion.html.
